items.title: PathoEvo: an interactive single-cell database for exploring disease progression and pathological evolution.
items.title_zh: PathoEvo：一个用于探索疾病进展和病理演化的交互式单细胞数据库。
items.summary_zh: 疾病进展由组织微环境、细胞组成、细胞状态和转录程序的协同变化驱动。单细胞和单核RNA测序使这些变化能够在细胞分辨率下研究。然而，公共疾病相关数据集通常组织在单个研究内，并使用异质性临床、病理或分子分期系统注释，限制了跨疾病阶段和数据集比较。在此，我们介绍PathoEvo（https://biomedlab-ai.com/pathoevo/），一个以疾病进展为中心的疾病相关单细胞和单核转录组数据库。PathoEvo整合了来自981个样本和59个数据集的7 452 971个细胞或细胞核，覆盖18种疾病和27个进展框架。通过人工策展、统一处理、元数据协调、细胞类型注释和阶段映射，PathoEvo将异质性数据集组织为围绕疾病进展的标准化资源。其数据和分析功能跨越三个互补层面，允许用户检查与疾病阶段和细胞状态相关的细胞组成变化，表征跨疾病进展的样本级分子变异，并研究相关细胞群体和样本中的基因表达动态

extra.description: Disease progression is driven by coordinated changes in tissue microenvironments, cellular composition, cell states, and transcriptional programmes. Single-cell and single-nucleus RNA sequencing enable these changes to be studied at cellular resolution. However, public disease-associated datasets are often organized within individual studies and annotated using heterogeneous clinical, pathological, or molecular staging systems, limiting comparison across disease stages and datasets. Here, we present PathoEvo (https://biomedlab-ai.com/pathoevo/), a disease-associated single-cell and single-nucleus transcriptomic database centred on disease progression. PathoEvo integrates 7 452 971 cells or nuclei from 981 samples and 59 datasets, covering 18 diseases and 27 progression frameworks. Through manual curation, unified processing, metadata harmonization, cell-type annotation, and stage mapping, PathoEvo organizes heterogeneous datasets into standardized resources organized around disease progression. Its data and analytical functions span three complementary levels, allowing users to examine changes in cellular composition associated with disease stage and cell states, characterize sample-level molecular variation across disease progression, and investigate gene expression dynamics across relevant cell populations and samples. Structured search and browsing further facilitate dataset discovery and navigation of stage-resolved information across diseases and staging systems. PathoEvo provides an integrative resource for investigating pathological evolution and comparing cellular and molecular patterns of disease progression across datasets at single-cell resolution.

items.title: STRAND: a comprehensive subcellular-resolved spatial transcriptome RNA architecture and navigation database.
items.title_zh: STRAND：一个全面的亚细胞分辨率空间转录组RNA架构与导航数据库。
items.summary_zh: 亚细胞RNA定位是控制细胞极化、局部翻译和功能区室化的关键调控层。高分辨率空间转录组学的最新进展为在单分子分辨率下解析这些细胞内架构提供了前所未有的机会。然而，相关数据集分散在研究机构和存储库中，处理程序和标准差异很大，严重限制了跨研究复用。为弥合这一差距，我们推出STRAND（亚细胞分辨率空间转录组RNA架构与导航数据库），一个用于自动采集、质量控制和解释亚细胞空间转录组学数据的策展数据资源和分析平台。通过代理辅助策展流程，STRAND已从六个主要平台汇编了35个亚细胞分辨率数据集，覆盖人类和小鼠的17种组织类型，总计约49亿个转录本坐标。基于这一标准化数据资源，STRAND提供了涵盖细胞分割评估、细胞类型注释、RNA定位/共定位模式注释和亚细胞区室推断的分析工作流。两个案例研究表明，STRAND成功识别了培养细胞系中已建立的RNA定位模式，并检测了心肌细胞中药物诱导的RNA重定位。ST

extra.description: Subcellular RNA localization serves as a critical regulatory layer governing cellular polarization, local translation, and functional compartmentalization. Recent advances in high-resolution spatial transcriptomics have provided unprecedented opportunities to resolve these intracellular architectures at single-molecule resolution. However, relevant datasets are dispersed across studies and repositories, vary substantially in processing procedures and standards, severely limiting their cross-study reuse. To bridge this gap, we present STRAND (Subcellular-Resolved Spatial Transcriptome RNA Architecture and Navigation Database), a curated data resource and analysis platform for the automated harvesting, quality control, and interpretation of subcellular spatial transcriptomics data. Through an agent-assisted curation pipeline, STRAND has assembled 35 subcellular-resolution datasets from six major platforms, covering 17 tissue types in human and mouse and totalling ∼4.9 billion transcript coordinates. Building upon this standardized data resource, STRAND provides an analytical workflow spanning cell segmentation evaluation, cell-type annotation, RNA localization/colocalization pattern annotation, and subcellular compartment inference. Two case studies demonstrate that STRAND successfully identifies established RNA localization patterns in cultured cell lines and detects drug-induced RNA relocalization in cardiomyocytes. STRAND is openly available at https://strand.phasep.pro.

items.title: RankMap: rank-based reference mapping for fast and robust cell type annotation in spatial and single-cell transcriptomics
items.title_zh: RankMap：基于排名的参考映射，用于空间和单细胞转录组学中快速稳健的细胞类型注释

items.title: Cd47 deficiency in mouse brain under excitotoxic stress
items.title_zh: 兴奋性毒性应激下小鼠大脑中Cd47的缺失
items.summary_zh: CD47是一种具有明确免疫和神经发育作用的跨膜蛋白，最近被鉴定为人类、非人灵长类和小鼠中丰富的突触前蛋白。为研究Cd47如何影响神经元应激和损伤，我们对暴露于惊厥剂量（KA25；25 mg/kg）或亚惊厥剂量（KA3；3 mg/kg）海人藻酸（KA）的野生型（WT）和Cd47敲除（KO）小鼠海马进行了单核RNA测序。将细胞类型注释与加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）相结合，揭示了不同的神经元和胶质基因模块，其共表达结构因基因型和KA暴露而异。值得注意的是，某些模块仅在Cd47缺陷细胞中显示出与KA相关的共表达结构变化。这些模块的富集分析突出了翻译、生物能量和突触基因集。使用Wasserstein距离比较全转录组分布表明，在所有十五个成对比较中，载体处理的KO细胞最接近暴露于KA3的WT细胞。这些发现表明，Cd47缺失使海马转录组向类似轻度兴奋性毒性应激的状态转变，暗示Cd47是神经元应激

extra.description: CD47, a transmembrane protein with well-established immune and neurodevelopmental roles, was recently identified as an abundant presynaptic protein in humans, non-human primates, and mice. To investigate how Cd47 influences neuronal stress and injury, we performed single-nucleus RNA sequencing of hippocampi from wild-type (WT) and Cd47 knockout (KO) mice exposed to kainic acid (KA) at convulsive (KA25; 25 mg/kg) or subconvulsive (KA3; 3 mg/kg) doses. Integrating cell-type annotations with Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) revealed distinct neuronal and glial gene modules whose co-expression structure differed by genotype and by KA exposure. Notably, certain modules showed KA-associated changes in co-expression structure only in Cd47 -deficient cells. Enrichment analyses of these modules highlighted translational, bioenergetic, and synaptic gene sets. Comparing transcriptome-wide distributions using Wasserstein distance demonstrated that vehicle-treated KO cells most closely resembled WT cells exposed to KA3, of all fifteen pairwise comparisons. These findings suggest that Cd47 loss shifts the hippocampal transcriptome toward a state resembling mild excitotoxic stress, implicating Cd47 as a candidate regulator of neuronal stress adaptation and providing a hypothesis for testing that role.

items.title: OSCAR: an omics atlas of paired single-cell ATAC-seq and RNA-seq for decoding cell-specific gene regulation
items.title_zh: OSCAR：一个配对单细胞ATAC-seq和RNA-seq的组学图谱，用于解码细胞特异性基因调控
items.summary_zh: 摘要 配对的单细胞染色质可及性和转录组谱为剖析多种生物过程和人类疾病背后的细胞特异性调控程序提供了强大框架。配对单细胞转座酶可及染色质测序（scATAC-seq）和单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据的快速积累，迫切需要全面整合这些数据以在单细胞分辨率下阐明调控景观。为满足这一需求，我们开发了OSCAR（配对单细胞ATAC和RNA-seq组学图谱，https://bio.liclab.net/OSCAR/），以策展大规模配对scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq数据，并提供全面的调控注释和分析。当前版本的OSCAR收录了来自30种组织类型的1136个样本的7,749,898个人类细胞。重要的是，OSCAR整合了配对的scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq谱以进行联合细胞聚类和峰到基因连锁识别，并为标记峰和标记基因的调控元件提供详细的（表观）遗传注释，包括超级增强子、增强子、增强子

extra.description: Abstract Paired single-cell chromatin accessibility and transcriptome profiles provide a powerful framework for dissecting cell-specific regulatory programs underlying diverse biological processes and human diseases. The rapid accumulation of paired single-cell assay for transposase-accessible chromatin sequencing (scATAC-seq) and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data has led to an urgent need to comprehensively integrate these data to illustrate the regulatory landscape at single-cell resolution. To address this need, we developed OSCAR (an Omics atlas of paired Single-Cell ATAC and RNA-seq, https://bio.liclab.net/OSCAR/) to curate large-scale paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq data and to provide comprehensive regulatory annotations and analyses. The current version of OSCAR catalogs 7749 898 human cells from 1136 samples across 30 tissue types. Importantly, OSCAR integrates paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq profiles for joint cell clustering and peak-to-gene linkage identification, and provides detailed (epi)genetic annotations for marker peaks and regulatory elements of marker genes, including super-enhancers, enhancers, enhancer RNAs (eRNAs), common and risk single nucleotide polymorphisms, expression quantitative trait loci, transcription factor binding sites, transcription factor/transcription co-factor binding peaks, Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats (CRISPR)/Cas9 target sites, DNase I hypersensitivity sites, chromatin accessibility regions, DNA methylation sites, chromatin interaction regions, and topologically associating domains. Furthermore, OSCAR provides three online analysis tools, including cell type enrichment analysis, sequence-based peak regulatory analysis, and peak-to-gene linkage analysis. Hence, OSCAR is a useful platform to query, browse, analyze, and visualize cell-specific regulatory programs across diverse human tissues and diseases.

items.title: An extensible deep learning framework for multi-type chromatin interaction prediction through hierarchical adaptation strategies
items.title_zh: 一个通过分层适应策略进行多类型染色质相互作用预测的可扩展深度学习框架
items.summary_zh: 三维染色质相互作用在基因调控中起重要作用，然而多种相互作用类型的计算预测在很大程度上仍依赖于专门的单任务模型。在这里，我们提出UniLoopNet，一个多任务深度学习框架，可从DNA序列预测多种类型的染色质相互作用，包括增强子-启动子相互作用、增强子-增强子相互作用、CTCF介导的环和条纹相关相互作用。UniLoopNet采用共享编码器-解码器架构和分层适应策略，基于任务语义相似性整合多任务、迁移和持续学习。跨多个细胞系的全面基准测试表明，UniLoopNet优于现有的专门和多任务方法，大多数任务的AUROC超过0.90。在严格评估设置下，包括染色体匹配、距离匹配、现实不平衡和位点不相交测试，AUROC范围为0.8934至0.9366。在现实的1:5类别不平衡设置中，增强子-启动子和增强子-增强子相互作用预测的AUPRC分别为0.7956和0.6935。跨细胞系迁移实验进一步表明，将Uni

extra.description: Three-dimensional chromatin interactions play essential roles in gene regulation, yet computational prediction of diverse interaction types remains largely dependent on specialized, single-task models. Here, we present UniLoopNet, a multi-task deep learning framework that predicts multiple types of chromatin interactions including enhancer–promoter interactions, enhancer–enhancer interactions, CTCF-mediated loops, and stripe-associated interactions from DNA sequences. UniLoopNet employs a shared encoder–decoder architecture with hierarchical adaptation strategies, integrating multi-task, transfer, and continual learning based on task semantic similarity. Comprehensive benchmarking across multiple cell lines demonstrates that UniLoopNet outperforms existing specialized and multi-task approaches, with AUROCs exceeding 0.90 in most tasks. Under stringent evaluation settings, including chromosome-matched, distance-matched, realistic imbalanced, and locus-disjoint tests, AUROCs range from 0.8934 to 0.9366. In the realistic 1:5 class-imbalance setting, the AUPRCs for enhancer–promoter and enhancer–enhancer interaction prediction are 0.7956 and 0.6935, respectively. Cross-cell-line transfer experiments further show that applying UniLoopNet to another cell line requires adaptation by supervised fine-tuning on target-cell-line data, after which performance is comparable to that of within-cell-line training. Notably, the framework exhibits data efficiency in experiments with substantially reduced training data. Interpretability analyses reveal that the learned sequence features are associated with known transcription factor binding sites and uncover differential regulatory effects of disease-associated variants. UniLoopNet provides a versatile and data-efficient framework for sequence-based prediction and interpretation of diverse 3D genome interactions, complementing existing sequence-to-map approaches while improving the understanding of sequence-encoded regulatory potential.

items.title: CAnDi: a global catalogue of anaerobic digestion microbiomes.
items.title_zh: CAnDi：全球厌氧消化微生物组目录。
items.summary_zh: 产甲烷环境包含复杂的原核生物群落，驱动有机物厌氧转化为甲烷和二氧化碳。除了对全球碳循环至关重要外，这些过程已被引导为生物反应器中能源生产的强大生物技术。解码这些群落的功能和分类景观需要全面调查，包括噬菌体和质粒，然而这些在当前数据库中仍严重不足。在此，我们介绍厌氧消化微生物目录（CAnDi），一个包含36 480个原核基因组、跨越11 149个物种的数据库，这些基因组从全球生物反应器采集的1256个宏基因组样本中恢复。重建的宏基因组还编码约190万个病毒和超过13万个质粒序列。身份聚类揭示了约536 000个候选病毒物种，其中85%相对于现有数据库是新的，以及超过15 000个独特质粒。病毒和质粒蛋白簇从头生成，分别总计1 721 182和123 813个不同蛋白家族。这些资源共同大幅推进了先前表征厌氧消化微生物组的系统方法，为研究产甲烷生态系统中病毒组和质粒组的生态和进化作用提供了扩展基

extra.description: Methanogenic environments harbour complex prokaryotic consortia that drive the anaerobic conversion of organic matter into methane and carbon dioxide. Beyond being key to the global carbon cycle, such processes have been steered into powerful biotechnologies for energy production in bioreactors. Decoding the functional and taxonomic landscape of these communities requires comprehensive surveys, including bacteriophages and plasmids, which, however, remain vastly underrepresented in current databases. Here, we present the microbial Catalogue of Anaerobic Digestion (CAnDi), a database comprising 36 480 prokaryotic genomes spanning 11 149 species recovered from 1256 metagenomic samples collected across bioreactors worldwide. The reconstructed metagenomes also encode ∼1.9 million viral and over 130 000 plasmid sequences. Identity clustering revealed ∼536 000 candidate viral species, of which 85% are novel relative to existing databases, as well as over 15 000 unique plasmids. Clusters of viral and plasmid proteins were generated de novo, totalling 1 721 182 and 123 813 distinct protein families, respectively. Together, these resources substantially advance previous systematic approaches to characterize anaerobic digestion microbiomes, providing an expanded foundation for investigating the ecological and evolutionary roles of the virome and plasmidome in methane-producing ecosystems. CAnDi is accessible via https://www.candi-db.org/.

items.title: CircaVal: a gene-centric multi-omics platform for exploring circadian regulatory features
items.title_zh: CircaVal：一个以基因为中心的多组学平台，用于探索昼夜节律调控特征
items.summary_zh: 摘要 昼夜节律时钟通过协调多个分子层面上时钟控制基因表达来编排每日生理过程。然而，这种多层节律调控的系统表征仍然具有挑战性，因为相关信息分布在独立数据集中，且节律性使用多种分析方法评估。在此，我们开发了CircaVal，一个以基因为中心的多组学平台，用于整合探索和解释人类、小鼠和狒狒的昼夜节律调控特征。为支持该框架，CircaVal使用标准化的、数据类型特定的流程处理公共数据集，并将基因节律性与组织特异性表达、跨物种直系同源、功能注释和多组学调控特征整合。CircaVal进一步引入了整合节律性评分（IRS），它结合多种节律检测方法的一致性和独立数据集间的可重复性，为优先考虑候选节律基因提供定量基础。该平台使用户能够检查跨数据集的基因节律性、识别组织富集的节律基因、比较跨物种的节律性并探索相关调控特征。附加功能包括交互式以基因为中心的探索、基因组浏览器可视化、用户上传时间序列数据的节律性分析

extra.description: Abstract The circadian clock orchestrates daily physiological processes through coordinated regulation of clock-controlled gene expression across multiple molecular layers. However, systematic characterization of this multilayered rhythmic regulation remains challenging because relevant information is distributed across independent datasets and rhythmicity is evaluated using diverse analytical approaches. Here, we developed CircaVal, a gene-centric multi-omics platform for the integrated exploration and interpretation of circadian regulatory features in humans, mice, and baboons. To support this framework, CircaVal processes public datasets using standardized, data-type-specific pipelines, and gene rhythmicity is integrated with tissue-specific expression, cross-species orthology, functional annotations, and multi-omics regulatory features. CircaVal further introduces an integrated rhythmicity score (IRS), which combines concordance across multiple rhythm-detection methods with reproducibility across independent datasets to provide a quantitative basis for prioritizing candidate rhythmic genes. The platform enables users to examine gene rhythmicity across datasets, identify tissue-enriched rhythmic genes, compare rhythmicity across species, and explore associated regulatory features. Additional functions include interactive gene-centric exploration, genome-browser visualization, rhythmicity analysis of user-uploaded time-series data, and programmatic data access. Together, these capabilities provide an integrated framework for rhythmic gene prioritization and gene-level interpretation of circadian regulatory features across tissues, species, datasets, and omics data types. CircaVal is freely available at https://CircaVal.com.

items.title: RNAactDrug 2.0: an updated resource for systematically exploring molecular features associated with drug sensitivity across multi-omics datasets
items.title_zh: RNAactDrug 2.0：一个更新的资源，用于系统探索跨多组学数据集中与药物敏感性相关的分子特征
items.summary_zh: 摘要 RNAactDrug 2.0（可在https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/RNAactDrug或https://bio-datamining.hrbmu.edu.cn/RNAactDrug获取）是一个更新的资源，用于系统探索跨多组学数据集中与药物敏感性相关的分子特征。我们更新了RNAactDrug 2.0数据库，显著扩展了数据并改进了功能，包括：(i) 来自大规模药物基因组学数据库的约30 000种药物、38 908个RNA分子和22 800 375个药物–RNA关联，涵盖四个分子层：表达、拷贝数变异（CNV）、突变和甲基化；(ii) 整合了来自The Cancer Genome Atlas的33种癌症类型的11 099个病例，以支持药物敏感性相关RNA特征的临床和泛癌分析；(iii) 来自>200个单细胞RNA测序数据集的约380万个细胞，涵盖34种癌症类

extra.description: Abstract RNAactDrug 2.0 (available at https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/RNAactDrug or https://bio-datamining.hrbmu.edu.cn/RNAactDrug) is an updated resource for systematically exploring molecular features associated with drug sensitivity across multi-omics datasets. We have updated the RNAactDrug 2.0 database with significantly expanded data and improved features, including (i) ∼30 000 drugs, 38 908 RNA molecules, and 22 800 375 drug–RNA associations from large-scale pharmacogenomic databases, covering four molecular layers: expression, copy number variation (CNV), mutation, and methylation; (ii) 11 099 cases from The Cancer Genome Atlas across 33 cancer types are integrated to support clinical and pan-cancer analyses of drug sensitivity-associated RNA features; (iii) ∼3.8 million cells from >200 single-cell RNA sequencing datasets, spanning 34 cancer types and 38 tissues, enable analysis of cell type-specific patterns and intratumoral heterogeneity; (iv) 26 440 enhancers and 788 444 drug-enhancer associations, combined with potential target prediction, provide an exploratory epigenetic regulatory dimension; (v) enhanced search and browsing functionalities, together with seven tools for functional annotation, pan-cancer analysis, tumor microenvironment profiling, single-cell trajectory and CNV analysis, and enhancer-related analyses. In summary, RNAactDrug 2.0 is a crucial resource for the multi-omics dissection of drug sensitivity-associated molecules, providing important support for the discovery of drug resistance biomarkers and the advancement of personalized therapeutic strategies.

items.title: AnnelidaDB: a comprehensive platform of taxonomic and multi-omic resources across annelids.
items.title_zh: AnnelidaDB：一个涵盖环节动物分类学和多组学资源的综合平台。
items.summary_zh: 环节动物栖息于海洋、淡水和陆地生态系统，是研究动物进化、再生和宿主-微生物相互作用的重要模型，然而其快速增长的组学资源仍分散在存储库和出版物中。我们开发了AnnelidaDB（www.annelidadb.com），一个基于更新系统发育框架的以物种为中心的数据库，整合了环节动物的基因组、线粒体基因组、转录组、蛋白质组、表观基因组、单细胞数据集、宿主相关共生体基因组和比较共线性。当前版本覆盖1121个物种，包括152个有核基因组的物种、177个有线粒体基因组的物种、591个有转录组数据的物种、5个有单细胞数据集的物种（包含209 802个细胞）和30个细菌共生体基因组。AnnelidaDB通过10个导航目录组织这些资源，并连接物种、基因组、基因、功能注释和基因家族记录。用户可以浏览基因组组装、探索交互式单细胞图谱和12 200个预计算Oxford图、运行BLAST查询并在环节动物特异性数据库

extra.description: Annelids inhabit marine, freshwater, and terrestrial ecosystems and are important models for studying animal evolution, regeneration, and host-microbe interactions, yet their rapidly growing omics resources remain dispersed across repositories and publications. We developed AnnelidaDB (www.annelidadb.com), a species-centred database built on an updated phylogenetic framework that integrates genomes, mitochondrial genomes, transcriptomes, proteomes, epigenomes, single-cell datasets, host-associated symbiont genomes, and comparative synteny for Annelida. The current release covers 1121 species, including 152 species with nuclear genomes, 177 with mitochondrial genomes, 591 with transcriptome data, 5 with single-cell datasets comprising 209 802 cells, and 30 bacterial symbiont genomes. AnnelidaDB organizes these resources through 10 navigation directories and connects species, genome, gene, functional annotation, and gene-family records. Users can browse genomic assemblies, explore interactive single-cell atlases and 12 200 precomputed Oxford plots, run BLAST queries and search genes against the annelid-specific database, and submit chromosome-level data for syntenic analysis against 20 Annelida linkage groups. Sequences, annotations, and private results are available for download. As a comprehensive multi-omics resource dedicated to annelids, AnnelidaDB provides an accessible platform for comparative investigations of annelid genome evolution, adaptation, regeneration, and symbiosis.

extra.description: Abstract Background Antimicrobial resistance is one of the most pressing global public health challenges, with vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus (VRE) listed as a high-priority pathogen by the World Health Organization. Animal gut environments harbor actinomycetes with unique biosynthetic potential due to long-term coevolution with hosts. Pheretima aspergillum , a medicinal earthworm used in traditional Chinese medicine, continuously ingests complex organic substrates, creating selective pressures that may drive the evolution of novel secondary metabolic pathways in its gut symbionts. However, the diversity, culturable resources, and anti-VRE potential of gut actinomycetes from P. aspergillum remain largely unexplored. Results This study presents the first systematic characterization of the gut actinomycete diversity of P. aspergillum . High-throughput 16 S ribosomal RNA (16 S rRNA) amplicon sequencing revealed that the gut bacterial community of P. aspergillum is highly diverse, comprising 21 phyla, 75 classes, 141 orders, 263 families, 501 genera, and 608 putative species. Actinomycetota ranked as the third most dominant phylum (10.2% relative abundance). A total of 414 culturable gut-associated bacterial isolates were recovered using eight culture media, of which 332 (80.2%) were actinomycetes; 26 of the 414 isolates (6.3%) were identified as putative novel species. Strain CB1-10-1, identified as Streptomyces chartreusis , exhibited broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity against vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecalis (VREfa) and other pathogens. Whole-genome sequencing and genome mining identified 38 biosynthetic gene clusters (BGC). One type II polyketide synthase cluster showed a high-confidence match to the characterized benastatin BGC (BGC0000204.5). Integrated metabolomic analysis further confirmed the production of benastatin analogues. Guided by this multi-omics strategy, benastatin B and benastatin C were isolated and structurally identified, representing the first report of benastatin production by S. chartreusis . Moreover, this study is the first to demonstrate that benastatin B exhibits potent anti-VREfa activity, with a minimum inhibitory concentration of 2 µg/mL and a minimum bactericidal concentration of 4 µg/mL – both superior to vancomycin – and it shows bactericidal properties. Conclusions This study establishes P. aspergillum as a productive source of actinomycete diversity harboring potential novel species. The multi-omics-guided discovery approach led to the identification of benastatin B as a promising bactericidal lead compound against VREfa infections, providing proof-of-concept for the value of animal symbiotic actinomycetes in antimicrobial drug discovery and a foundation for future mechanistic and preclinical studies.

items.title_zh: 小鼠大脑中跨遗传背景转录差异的空间单细胞图谱。
items.summary_zh: 遗传变异可改变器官结构和功能。跨遗传背景的器官比较统计分析需要空间、单细胞、图谱规模的重复数据。在此我们介绍使用聚合特征（ATLAS）的图谱规模转录组定位，一种可扩展的组织映射方法，从单细胞RNA测序数据学习转录特征，用数万个寡核苷酸探针原位编码并解码以推断细胞类型和插补转录组。我们通过标记基因的直接MERFISH测量以及与其他四种技术的定量比较验证了ATLAS。我们分析了来自五只雄性和五只雌性C57BL/6J小鼠以及五只雄性BTBR T+tf/J小鼠（一种特发性自闭症模型）中央大脑的400多个冠状切片中的4000万个细胞。我们的分析揭示了40多个细胞类型分布的显著差异，并在雄-雌和B6-BTBR比较中鉴定了16个区域组成变化。因此ATLAS能够进行系统比较研究，促进疾病模型的器官级结构-功能分析。

extra.description: Genetic variation can alter organ structure and function. Comparative statistical analysis of organs across genetic backgrounds requires spatial, single-cell, atlas-scale data in replicates. Here we introduce atlas-scale transcriptome localization using aggregate signatures (ATLAS), a scalable tissue mapping method that learns transcriptional signatures from single-cell RNA sequencing data, encodes them in situ with tens of thousands of oligonucleotide probes and decodes them to infer cell types and imputed transcriptomes. We validated ATLAS against direct MERFISH measurements of marker genes and through quantitative comparisons to four other technologies. We profiled 40 million cells across more than 400 coronal sections from central brains of five male and five female C57BL/6J mice and five male BTBR T+tf/J mice, an idiopathic autism model. Our analysis revealed more than 40 significant differences in cell-type distributions and identified 16 regional composition changes across male-female and B6-BTBR comparisons. ATLAS thus enables systematic comparative studies, facilitating organ-level structure-function analysis of disease models.

extra.description: Sex is a critical determinant of cancer susceptibility, clinical prognosis, and therapeutic response. Sex chromosome aberrations, particularly somatic loss of the Y chromosome (LOY) in male malignancies, exert profound impacts on transcriptional regulation, tumor immune microenvironment remodeling, and malignant progression, highlighting an urgent demand for comprehensive integration of single-cell and spatial omics profiles dissecting sex-biased and LOY landscapes across human cancers. Here, we developed XYcellAtlas (http://www.xycellatlas.top/), an integrative database for integration and multidimensional visualization of sex disparities and LOY features across human tissues at single-cell transcriptomic, epigenomic, and spatial-transcriptomic resolutions. This resource aggregates data from 6764 patient samples covering 18 cancer types, eight precancerous lesions, and 21 tissue origins, encompassing over 25.8 million single cells and one million spatial-transcriptomic spots. Leveraging random forest classifiers trained on normal tissue datasets, XYcellAtlas quantifies cell-type-specific LOY frequencies across cell types. Furthermore, it systematically catalogs sex-biased and LOY-associated molecular alterations, including differentially expressed genes, chromatin peaks, core transcription factors, as well as their functional annotations and dysregulatory signatures within malignant cells and the tumor microenvironment. In summary, XYcellAtlas provides a unified, all-in-one analytical platform enabling researchers to query, inspect, quantify, and visualize sex-associated and LOY-derived multi-omics features underlying tumor evolutionary processes.

items.title: DiseaseCIO: a multi-omics atlas for characterizing clinical intervention outcomes across diverse diseases.
items.title_zh: DiseaseCIO：一个用于表征多种疾病临床干预结局的多组学图谱。
items.summary_zh: 患者间临床干预结局的异质性是精准医学的主要障碍。多维高通量组学的整合有助于揭示临床干预差异的分子基础，并为结局预测、预后分层、调控模式和耐药机制提供见解。我们推出DiseaseCIO（疾病临床干预结局，http://db.edbc.org/DiseaseCIO/），一个将微生物组、转录组和表观基因组数据与人类疾病干预结局整合的数据库。它旨在在个体患者水平上表征与疾病干预结局相关的分子景观。DiseaseCIO涵盖来自94种疾病状态的42,798个治疗前样本，覆盖510种治疗方案，涉及377种药理学和非药理学干预。这些样本包括从八个采样地点收集的四种标本类型。使用定制的iMOD工作流进行多组学数据处理，我们生成了20类分子特征，并识别了超过184万个候选特征-结局关联。DiseaseCIO还提供交互式工具，用于差异分析、预后评估、跨组学相关分析和多维特征的跨队列整合分析，以及用户提交特征集的

extra.description: Heterogeneity in clinical intervention outcomes across patients is a major barrier to precision medicine. The integration of multidimensional high-throughput omics can help reveal the molecular basis of differences in clinical interventions and provide insights into outcome prediction, prognostic stratification, regulatory patterns, and resistance mechanisms. We present DiseaseCIO (Disease Clinical Intervention Outcomes, http://db.edbc.org/DiseaseCIO/), a database that integrates microbiome, transcriptome, and epigenome data with human disease intervention outcomes. It is designed to characterize the molecular landscape associated with disease intervention outcomes at the individual patient level. DiseaseCIO encompasses 42 798 pretreatment samples from 94 disease states, covering 510 treatment regimens involving 377 pharmacological and non-pharmacological interventions. These samples comprise four types of specimens collected from eight sampling locations. Using the customized iMOD workflow for multi-omics data processing, we generated 20 categories of molecular features and identified >1.84 million candidate feature-outcome associations. DiseaseCIO also provides interactive tools for differential analysis, prognostic evaluation, cross-omics correlation analysis, and cross-cohort integrative analysis of multidimensional features as well as enrichment analysis and signature construction for user-submitted feature sets. DiseaseCIO provides a molecular-level resource for exploring intervention outcome heterogeneity across diseases and identifying candidate multi-omics biomarkers associated with treatment response and prognosis.

extra.description: Abstract Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified numerous loci associated with complex diseases and traits, yet the functional interpretation of non-coding risk variants remains challenging. Sequence-to-function models like AlphaGenome provide large-scale multi-modal predictions of variant effects, but their predictions lack direct experimental support. In contrast, empirical resources such as molecular quantitative trait loci (QTLs) and massively parallel reporter assays (MPRAs) offer population-based or experimental support for variant function, but suffer from limited genomic coverage. Here, we present VarNexus (https://biomed.imu.edu.cn/varnexus), an integrative resource for connecting disease-associated variants with predicted, population-based, and experimental evidence. VarNexus currently contains 230 404 fine-mapped candidate variants across 1891 disease-related phenotypes from UK Biobank and FinnGen. It integrates precomputed AlphaGenome predictions across 11 regulatory output types with bulk and single-cell xQTLs, MPRA measurements, and GWAS-eQTL colocalization results. VarNexus enables cross-linked searches by variant, phenotype, and gene, together with on-demand AlphaGenome prediction, multi-omics genome-browser visualization, and regulatory network exploration. By combining sequence-based predictions with population-based and experimental evidence, VarNexus provides a framework for prioritizing candidate regulatory mechanisms supported by multiple evidence layers.

extra.description: Abstract The updated CellMarker 3.0 resource (http://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/CellMarker) offers a comprehensive resource, integrating experimentally validated and robustly algorithm-predicted marker genes for diverse cell types across human and mouse tissues. In addition, web tools for analyzing single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq) and spatial transcriptomics (ST) data are described. CellMarker 3.0 was updated with more data and new features, including (i) appending 274 tissues, 1877 cell types, 64 040 markers, and 1 245 923 tissue–cell type–marker entries over the previous version. The current release contains 930 tissues, 4455 cell types, and 90 955 cell markers, resulting in a total of 1 329 284 tissue–cell type–marker entries. (ii) Expanding the resource to include computationally predicted cell-type markers derived from six algorithms, namely Spapros, Seurat::FindAllMarkers, SEMITONES, Cepo, CelliD, and COSG. (iii) New marker information was incorporated from 168 sequencing technologies, such as CEL-Seq2 and SNARE-seq. (iv) Covering 35 types of cell markers, including protein–coding genes, rRNAs, and pseudogenes. (v) The cell tool module was comprehensively restructured and upgraded, with the original six scRNA-seq analysis modules systematically optimized and two new spatial transcriptomics modules, Spatial Expression, and Spatial Chat, added. CellMarker 3.0 is a valuable resource that integrates cell identity identification, single-cell transcriptomics, and spatial transcriptomics analysis.

items.title_zh: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

items.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法

items.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。

<p<随着云边端协同计算与物联网技术的深度融合，动态异构网络中的海量终端已成为网络安全体系中的核心防护对象。这些智能终端在持续运行过程中产生网络流量、工控传感日志等多元时间序列数据，承载着终端行为的完整语义信息。因此，对此类时间序列数据进行精准分类是实现终端威胁检测的关键技术。然而，终端异质性引发的数据分布不均衡问题，使现有时序分类模型面临三重挑战：1）受限于固定分辨率的处理范式，模型难以捕捉不同时间尺度下的多粒度威胁特征；2）现有方法通常将所有分辨率特征映射至统一高维空间，忽视了不同时间分辨率在特征维度分布上的内在差异，导致噪声引入与特征冗余，制约了模型在计算资源受限的边缘终端上的部署适配能力；3）使用多分辨率进行联合推理，各分辨率分支的特征提取与融合过程带来显著的计算与存储开销，加剧了轻量化部署与高精度检测之间的固有矛盾。为了解决时间分辨率与特征维度适配的问题，提出了面向动态异构网络的自适应多分辨率表示学习（adaptive multi-resolution representation learning，AdaMRL）模型，实现了时间分辨率与特征维度的双向对齐解耦。首先，构建了多分辨率嵌套表征架构，提出多分辨率与嵌套维度自适应匹配机制，为每个时间分辨率独立配备嵌套表示学习层，自动选择最优的维度进行嵌套表示学习；其次，提出了多分辨率联合损失监督机制，在训练阶段对各分辨率表征进行同步约束，增强跨分辨率特征的鲁棒性并加快模型收敛；最后，设计了自适应维度选择与集成策略，在推理阶段为不同分辨率动态匹配最优特征维度，并通过软投票机制实现协同决策。在10个UEA多变量时间序列基准数据集与工业物联网边缘安全基准数据集Edge-IIoTset上的广泛实验表明，AdaMRL达到了当前先进的分类性能。与基准模型相比，所提方法平均分类准确率提升0.78个百分点，并在最佳自适应配置下将冗余特征参数计算量降低27.3%，在检测精度与计算效率之间实现了有效平衡，为边缘异质终端的实时安全防护提供了有力支撑。</p<


计算机研究与发展. 2026 63(10): 2632-2649.

items.title: 基于双重异常感知的时间序列异常检测
items.title_zh: 基于双重异常感知的时间序列异常检测
items.summary_zh:

items.title: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.title_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统,也叫智能体操作系统,是整合大模型、工具资源以及多智能体协同的核心平台,目前正逐渐成为推动通用人工智能发展的一个关键研究方向。对智能体操作系统领域的研究进展进行了系统梳理,首先从基础理论着手,回顾了多种大模型的演进情况以及智能体和传统操作系统领域的进展;接着,围绕典型体系结构,如AIOS等,阐述了其分层架构与模块化设计是怎样达成资源管理与智能调度的。进一步地,明确了当前智能体操作系统在上下文整合、扩展性以及安全性等方面面临的技术挑战,同时也提出了未来借助轻量化设计、自监督学习机制以及动态调度算法来提升多智能体协作效率。该研究的主要贡献为,将那些分散的研究给予整合,促使技术框架变得更为明晰,并指出了智能体操作系统对新兴体系以及行业定制化实践覆盖不全面的情况。未来的研究需要侧重推动跨域智能体操作系统自我进化的能力,并且加快其在各个领域的落地等。

items.title: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.title_zh: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.summary_zh: 近年来,大语言模型(Large Language Models,LLMs)技术迎来了快速发展,其在各行业的应用呈现出蓬勃增长的态势。从自然语言处理到智能推荐,再到信息检索和自动化写作,LLMs正逐渐成为许多领域中不可或缺的工具。然而,随着应用场景的逐渐多样化和需求的不断增加,LLMs推理效率问题日益凸显。在实际应用场景中,快速准确的推理能力对于响应用户请求、处理大规模数据和实时决策至关重要。为了应对这一挑战,学术界展开了广泛的研究和探索,致力于提高LLMs的推理效率。对此,全面调研了实际应用场景中有关LLMs高效推理的文献。首先,介绍了LLMs推理的原理,并分析了在实际应用场景中如何提高LLMs的推理效率。然后,引入了一个针对实际应用场景的分类系统,其主要分为3个层面,分别是算法优化层面、参数优化层面和系统优化层面;并对大模型进行相关研究的总结和归纳。最后,探讨了未来可能的研究方向。

items.title: CellMethMarker provides an integrated database of human cell- and tissue-type-specific DNA methylation markers
items.title_zh: CellMethMarker提供人类细胞和组织类型特异性DNA甲基化标记的综合数据库
items.summary_zh: 细胞和组织类型特异性DNA甲基化标记提供细胞身份的的表观遗传特征，广泛用于从 bulk 和单细胞甲基化组推断细胞来源。现有资源主要强调疾病相关生物标志物、甲基化组图谱、基因组注释或基于RNA的细胞标记，留下对专门针对此类标记的整合区域级资源的未满足需求。在此我们展示CellMethMarker（http://gu-zhanglab.hfcas.ac.cn/CellMethMarker），一个 curated 数据库，整合了来自统一处理的全基因组和简化代表性亚硫酸氢盐测序数据集的347,514个 de novo 标记、2,203,507条文献来源标记记录和2,810个样本的协调元数据。CellMethMarker支持以细胞和组织为中心的标记检索、基于坐标的搜索、基因组浏览器可视化、交互式甲基化分析和数据下载。在一个独立的单细胞甲基化组图谱中，这些标记恢复了预期的细胞类型相关甲基化模式，由它们

extra.description: Cell- and tissue-type-specific DNA methylation markers provide epigenetic signatures of cellular identity and are widely used to infer cellular origin from bulk and single-cell methylomes. Existing resources mainly emphasize disease-associated biomarkers, methylome atlases, genomic annotations or RNA-based cell markers, leaving an unmet need for an integrated region-level resource dedicated to such markers. Here we present CellMethMarker (http://gu-zhanglab.hfcas.ac.cn/CellMethMarker), a curated database integrating 347,514 de novo markers derived from uniformly processed whole-genome and reduced-representation bisulfite sequencing datasets, 2,203,507 literature-derived marker records and harmonized metadata for 2,810 samples. CellMethMarker enables cell- and tissue-centered marker retrieval, coordinate-based search, genome-browser visualization, interactive methylation analysis and data download. In an independent single-cell methylome atlas, these markers recover the expected cell-type-associated methylation patterns, and a platform-matched reference built from them lowers the mean deconvolution error from 0.365 to 0.144. CellMethMarker therefore links region-level DNA methylation variation to cellular identity and supports methylome-based cell-type annotation and deconvolution.

items.title: HELICS: Biobank-scale Conditional Synthetic Genome Generation via Latent Flow Matching
items.title_zh: HELICS：通过潜在流匹配进行生物样本库规模的条件合成基因组生成
items.summary_zh: 个体水平基因型数据支撑遗传发现、疾病风险建模和治疗开发，然而许多关键场景仍数据有限，包括代表性不足的祖先群体、罕见或不平衡疾病队列以及受限访问的生物样本库。条件合成基因组生成将支持隐私感知的基准测试、模拟和数据增强，但需要学习数十万至数千万相关单核苷酸多态性（SNPs，即DNA变异位点）上的超高维离散分布。我们引入HELICS：通过潜在插值条件合成的高保真生成，一个无定相潜在流匹配框架，用于从生物样本库规模基因型数据进行全基因组SNP水平生成。HELICS用卷积自编码器对染色体进行标记化，将>600K SNPs缩减为4,096个连续潜在标记，并在拼接的多染色体潜在表示上训练参数化条件流匹配的transformer模型。在英国生物样本库超过417K基因组上训练，HELICS无需单倍型定相即可生成全基因组常见变异合成队列，并比现有基于单倍型的模拟器更忠实于真实基因型，包括外部评估中高等位基因频

extra.description: Individual-level genotype data underpin genetic discovery, disease-risk modeling, and therapeutic development, yet many critical settings remain data-limited, including underrepresented ancestries, rare or imbalanced disease cohorts, and restricted-access biobanks. Conditional synthetic genome generation would support privacy-aware benchmarking, simulation, and data augmentation, but requires learning an ultra-high-dimensional discrete distribution over hundreds of thousands to tens of millions of correlated single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), or sites of DNA variation. We introduce HELICS: High-fidelity gEneration via Latent Interpolant Conditional Synthesis, a phasing-free latent flow matching framework for genome-wide SNP-level generation from biobank-scale genotype data. HELICS tokenizes chromosomes with convolutional autoencoders, reducing >600K SNPs to 4,096 continuous latent tokens, and trains a transformer parameterized conditional flow matching model over the concatenated multi-chromosome latent representation. Trained on over 417K genomes in the UK Biobank, HELICS generates genome-wide common-variant synthetic cohorts without haplotype phasing and achieves stronger fidelity to real genotypes than existing haplotype-based simulators, including high allele-frequency agreement in external evaluation and superior preservation of local and long-range SNP correlation structure. Conditioning on ancestry and genetic liability summaries enables targeted generation across genetic risk profiles; in perturbation analyses, by increasing the conditioned disease trait liability, HELICS induces SNP-level dosage changes in generated genomes that are highly correlated with published association weights. HELICS provides a scalable generative modeling framework for SNP-level genome data and a path toward conditional synthetic cohorts for data-limited genetic studies.

items.title: GraphTFactor: A graph-based approach for proteins transcription factor prediction
items.title_zh: GraphTFactor：一种基于图的蛋白质转录因子预测方法
items.summary_zh: 转录因子（TF）在调控基因表达中发挥重要作用，使其识别成为计算生物学的基本任务。在这项工作中，我们提出GraphTFactor，一种新颖的端到端框架，将蛋白质序列建模为图并直接分类转录因子。通过将序列编码为图结构，所提方法自然处理可变长度输入，同时保留相关关系信息，而不施加长度约束。实验结果表明，GraphTFactor在基准数据集上优于最先进方法，展示了基于图的表示用于TF预测的有效性，同时提供对模型预测贡献序列区域的可解释见解。为支持可重复性和实际采用，我们发布了一个开源软件包和一个交互式网络应用，使用户能够轻松对自定义序列进行TF预测。

extra.description: Transcription factors (TFs) play an important role in regulating gene expression, making their identification a fundamental task in computational biology. In this work, we propose GraphTFactor, a novel end-to-end framework that models protein sequences as graphs and directly classifies transcription factors. By encoding sequences into graph structures, the proposed approach naturally handles variable-length inputs while preserving relevant relational information, without imposing length constraints. Experimental results show that GraphTFactor outperforms state-of-the-art methods on benchmark datasets, demonstrating the effectiveness of graph-based representations for TF prediction while providing interpretable insights into the sequence regions contributing to the model's predictions. To support reproducibility and practical adoption, we release an open-source software package and an interactive web application that let users easily perform TF prediction on custom sequences.

items.title: Informed, scalable and unified transport couplings for single-cell alignment and downstream inference with scBIOT
items.title_zh: 知情、可扩展且统一的传输耦合用于单细胞对齐和下游推断，使用scBIOT
items.summary_zh: 单细胞基因组学需要能够在保留生物信号的同时考虑技术变异、在图谱规模上保持可处理性并支持超越可视化的分析的方法，但现有方法丢弃了可能连接这些任务的拟合对应关系。在此我们介绍scBIOT，一个生物学信息引导的最优传输框架，将单细胞对齐表述为细胞之间显式且可检查的耦合。scBIOT整合先验生物学知识以保留已知细胞身份，通过原型压缩传输以处理大型数据集，并使用耦合衍生的传输分数量化对齐引起的基因水平变化。在转录组和空间映射基准上，scBIOT在区分批次相关应激反应与生物免疫和药物反应程序的同时，平衡了生物保守性、批次校正和标签转移准确性。原型传输将基于耦合的分析扩展到约1亿个扰动细胞。由于耦合编码的是概率对应关系而不仅仅是校正后的坐标，同一拟合耦合支持状态映射、轨迹推断、扰动分析、多模态比较和时空定位。在癌症、造血和胚胎发育中的应用识别了条件特异性细胞状态、模态依赖性调控程序以及空间分辨的发育转变

extra.description: Single-cell genomics requires methods that account for technical variation while preserving biological signals, remain tractable at atlas scale and support analyses beyond visualization, but existing approaches discard the fitted correspondence that could connect these tasks. Here we introduce scBIOT, a biologically informed optimal-transport framework that formulates single-cell alignment as an explicit and inspectable coupling between cells. scBIOT incorporates prior biological knowledge to preserve known cell identities, compresses transport through prototypes for large datasets and quantifies gene-level changes induced by alignment using coupling-derived transport scores. Across transcriptomic and spatial mapping benchmarks, scBIOT balanced biological conservation, batch correction and label-transfer accuracy while distinguishing batch-associated stress responses from biological immune and drug-response programs. Prototype transport scaled coupling-based analysis to approximately 100 million perturbed cells. Because the coupling encodes probabilistic correspondences rather than only corrected coordinates, the same fitted coupling supports state mapping, trajectory inference, perturbation analysis, multimodal comparison and spatiotemporal localization. Applications to cancer, hematopoiesis and embryonic development identified condition-specific cell states, modality-dependent regulatory programs and spatially resolved developmental transitions. Informed, scalable and unified transport couplings therefore link atlas alignment to downstream biological inference within a single framework.

items.title: An autoencoder outperforms two transformers on prediction of gene expression from chromatin accessibility
items.title_zh: 自编码器在从染色质可及性预测基因表达上优于两个 transformer
items.summary_zh: 从染色质可及性预测 RNA 丰度的模型很少在相同特征、目标和指标下比较。我们在来自 19 项人类研究的 126,604 个配对单核图谱上构建了一个基准，共享 50,000 个峰和 3,185 个基因的词表、十个 5x2 交叉验证折和一个评分目标，并在 70 次训练运行中比较了七个已实现流程和两个参考预测器；每个流程保留自己的输入归一化和原生训练目标。基于双变分自编码器的 scButterfly-B 流程在所有六十个配对折比较中，在每基因和细胞内 Spearman 相关上优于所有 transformer 流程，包括自回归 Perceiver 模型（Omic Translator）和无支持重构的 Cisformer，训练时间短 3.8 倍。Transformer 流程在细胞内轮廓形状上差距为 0.02-0.04，但在每基因相关上落后 0.10-0.24。在两个留出细胞类型上每基因相关较低；对照

extra.description: Models that predict RNA abundance from chromatin accessibility are rarely compared under the same features, targets and metrics. We built one benchmark on 126,604 paired single-nucleus profiles from 19 human studies with a shared vocabulary of 50,000 peaks and 3,185 genes, ten 5x2 cross-validation folds and one scoring target, and compared seven implemented pipelines and two reference predictors across 70 trained runs; each pipeline keeps its own input normalisation and native training target. The scButterfly-B pipeline, built on dual variational autoencoders, outperformed every transformer pipeline, including an autoregressive Perceiver model (Omic Translator) and a support-free reformulation of Cisformer, on per-gene and within-cell Spearman correlation in all sixty paired fold comparisons, with 3.8 times shorter training. Transformer pipelines come within 0.02-0.04 on within-cell profile shape but lag by 0.10-0.24 on per-gene correlation. On two withheld cell types per-gene correlation is low; controls show the podocyte values are typical of within-type correlation for seen cell types of the same size, whereas Paneth values match a cell-agnostic shuffle for every Omic Translator arm. Within the transformer family, prespecified ablations show the Perceiver encoder was worth +0.0439 in within-donor per-gene correlation over full self-attention, a chromosome-aware genomic attention prior reduced it by 0.0096 (exact donor-level sign-flip test, Holm-adjusted p = 1.2e-4), and decoder output order had no detectable effect. A training-mean profile reaches 0.314 within-cell correlation with no input and a constant at the true expressed-gene positions reaches 0.996 per-gene correlation, so oracle-support protocols are reported only as diagnostics. Code, results and an audited release are provided.

items.title: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
items.title_zh: OmicsBench：AI智能体在研究级生物信息学上的长时程多轮基准
items.summary_zh: 计算生物学家越来越多地将大量分析委托给AI智能体进行长时程、多轮会话，但大多数智能体生物信息学能力基准只提出单一短任务和单次提示。我们提出OmicsBench，一个面向AI智能体的长时程、多轮生物信息学基准。其97个任务各自将依赖子任务连接成有向无环图，总共662个底层子任务。每个子任务作为一个用户轮次提出，并针对答案键进行确定性评分，对错误答案提供可选的上下文反馈。在三种框架上的12个模型中，最慢的智能体平均每任务耗时3.6小时，没有任何组合接近饱和该基准，无上下文反馈时平均得分为0.43至0.57（满分1），有反馈时为0.54至0.67。多轮评估还揭示了单次提示无法发现的行为，因为智能体在依赖早期子任务的子任务上得分较低，而上下文反馈帮助智能体挽回部分损失。由于确定性评分无法定性说明智能体如何失败，我们还引入了一个无监督失败模式发现流程，用于描述、嵌入和聚类智能体的失败尝试，以揭示涌现

extra.description: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend on earlier subtasks, and in-context feedback helps agents recover some of that loss. Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes. Applied to OmicsBench, this pipeline exposes qualitative shortcomings in how agents carry out bioinformatics analyses, ranging from agents applying their own statistical filters in place of the specified ones to agents writing whole answers from memory.

items.title: HOMED enables hierarchical and multimodal optimization of DNA methylation deconvolution across tissues
items.title_zh: HOMED实现跨组织DNA甲基化去卷积的分层多模态优化
items.summary_zh: 细胞异质性是全表观基因组关联研究中bulk DNA甲基化数据的主要混杂因素。现有的基于参考的DNAm去卷积方法通常忽略相关细胞类型之间的层级关系，并且由于参考谱变异性有限，可能在不同数据集之间泛化不佳。我们开发了HOMED（分层优化甲基化去卷积），一个整合细胞谱系层级、单细胞RNA测序引导的去卷积以及配对bulk RNA-seq/DNAm数据进行CpG特征优化的框架。在模拟和真实的外周血单核细胞、肺和胎盘数据集中，HOMED始终产生最高的PCC和最低的RMSE，优于现有的scRNA-seq引导的DNAm去卷积方法，提高了准确性、分辨率和跨组织泛化能力。

extra.description: Cellular heterogeneity is a major confounder in bulk DNA methylation data for epigenome-wide association studies. Existing reference-based DNAm deconvolution methods often ignore hierarchies among related cell types and may generalize poorly across datasets due to limited variability in reference profiles. We developed HOMED (Hierarchically Optimized Methylation Deconvolution), a framework that integrates cell-lineage hierarchies, single-cell RNA sequencing-guided deconvolution, and paired bulk RNA-seq/DNAm data for CpG signature optimization. Across simulated and real peripheral blood mononuclear cell, lung, and placental datasets, HOMED consistently yielded the highest PCCs and lowest RMSEs, outperforming existing scRNA-seq-guided DNAm deconvolution methods, improving accuracy, resolution, and cross-tissue generalizability.

items.title: BARRR: Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression for Multi-View Multi-Cohort Data
items.title_zh: BARRR：用于多视图多队列数据的双向增强降秩回归
items.summary_zh: 跨多个队列（即样本组）和视图（即来源或模态）的双向数据整合在生物医学研究中至关重要，以从异质数据集中获得整体见解。然而，大多数现有整合方法侧重于单一维度，如跨不同来源的多视图整合或跨不同样本组的多队列整合。现有的双向整合方法稀缺且主要无监督，忽视了协变量提供的宝贵见解。为解决这一空白，我们引入双向增强降秩回归（baRRR）方法。我们的方法同时建模协变量相关和不相关效应，同时在两个维度上分解效应水平（全局、部分共享和个体）。大量模拟证明了我们的方法在信号恢复、结果预测和缺失数据插补方面的优势。我们将方法应用于癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）数据，使用体细胞突变作为协变量来告知不同组学平台和癌症类型间的变异模式。这些研究突出了其作为生物医学研究中稳健且适应性强的整合分析工具的潜力。

extra.description: Bidimensional data integration across multiple cohorts (i.e., sample groups) and views (i.e., sources or modalities) is crucial in biomedical research to derive holistic insights from heterogeneous datasets. However, most existing integrative methods focus on a single dimension, such as multi-view integration across distinct sources or multi-cohort integration across distinct sample groups. Existing approaches for bidimensional integration are scarce and predominantly unsupervised, overlooking the valuable insights offered by covariates. To address this gap, we introduce the Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression (baRRR) method. Our approach models covariate-related and unrelated effects concurrently, while also decomposing effect levels (global, partially shared, and individual) across both dimensions. Extensive simulations demonstrate the advantages of our method with respect to signal recovery, outcome prediction, and missing data imputation. We apply our approach to data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), using somatic mutations as covariates to inform patterns of variability across different omics platforms and cancer types. These studies highlight its potential as a robust and adaptable tool for integrative analysis in biomedical research.

items.title: Reducing double-dipping in single-cell topic models with three-way count splitting
items.title_zh: 用三向计数拆分减少单细胞主题模型中的双重 dipping
items.summary_zh: 主题模型从单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中学习基因程序，然后相同的计数被用于测试哪些基因和供体与这些程序相关。计数拆分是这种复用的标准补救措施，但当编码器读取每个细胞的计数时尚未被测试。在一个104,400细胞的狼疮队列中，每次运行300个置换零基因，朴素检验在名义5%水平下拒绝了36%的零基因-主题对，而通常的两向拆分拒绝了38%，因为编码器看到了被检验基因自身的留出计数。在单独的第三个计数上编码主题使用，使用beta-二项稀疏化，将此降低到7.7%（模型外基因为6.7%）；对于另外两个模型LDVAE和scETM，该率为7.0-7.3%（朴素为51-59%）。一个无标签干扰素程序在狼疮队列和预先指定的COVID-19队列的留出计数中发生偏移，供体水平主题使用预测疾病（AUROC 0.96），超越细胞类型比例（两个队列中分别为0.86和0.58）。校准和预测不依赖于模型。我们不

extra.description: Topic models learn gene programs from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data, and the same counts are then used to test which genes and donors are associated with those programs. Count splitting is the standard remedy for this reuse, but it has not been tested when an encoder reads each cell's counts. On a 104,400-cell lupus cohort with 300 permuted null genes per run, naive tests rejected 36% of null gene-topic pairs at a nominal 5% level, and the usual two-way split rejected 38%, because the encoder sees the tested gene's own held-out count. Encoding topic usage on a separate third of the counts, with beta-binomial thinning, lowered this to 7.7% (6.7% for genes outside the model); for two other models, LDVAE and scETM, the rate was 7.0-7.3% (naive 51-59%). A label-free interferon program shifts in held-out counts in the lupus cohort and in a pre-specified COVID-19 cohort, and donor-level topic usage predicts disease (AUROC 0.96) beyond cell-type proportions (0.86 and 0.58 in the two cohorts). Calibration and prediction did not depend on the model. We do not claim better clustering, prediction or topic stability. Code, figures and result tables are public (MIT license; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23307193).

items.title: Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity
items.title_zh: 理解基因表达到图像学习：空间结构与信息保真度
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）使生物异质性的细胞水平分析成为可能，但从高维、无序基因表达谱学习有效表示仍具挑战性。基因表达到图像（GE2I）通过将基因值排列在像素网格上供卷积神经网络使用，提供了一种有效学习策略，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们在全转录组数据上研究GE2I，同时保持网络和训练过程固定。我们的结果揭示了空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间的权衡。结构化映射产生平滑的低频模式，支持更快的早期优化，而将多个基因分配到同一像素会模糊表达差异并可能降低预测性能。这种权衡解释了为什么当表示许多基因时，随机映射可以与结构化布局竞争。即使图像平滑性降低，一对一基因到像素分配在测试的视觉骨干网络中也能改善预测。我们进一步发现预训练和增强的益处取决于骨干网络和映射。这些发现为像素分配和将视觉先验迁移到基因表达数据提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. This trade-off explains why random mappings can compete with structured layouts when many genes are represented. One-to-one gene-to-pixel assignment improves prediction across the tested visual backbones even when image smoothness decreases. We further find that the benefits of pretraining and augmentation depend on the backbone and mapping. These findings provide practical guidance for pixel allocation and the transfer of vision priors to gene expression data.

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
items.title_zh: 统一多模态模型的连续空间潜在推理
items.summary_zh: 统一多模态模型（UMM）在多样化的多模态理解和生成任务上取得了显著成功，但它们仍难以有效利用基于语言的思维链推理进行图像生成。因此，现有的推理增强UMM往往无法继承在大语言模型中观察到的测试时扩展和细粒度可控性。我们将这一失败归因于根本性的模态不匹配：推理在离散token空间中进行，而图像生成在连续空间中运行。为弥合这一差距，我们引入了连续空间潜在推理框架（LARC），通过对连续隐藏状态进行推理来缓解token级瓶颈。具体而言，训练框架包括两个阶段：（i）课程监督微调（SFT），和（ii）信息增益强化学习（RL）。首先，课程SFT阶段逐步将token级推理转换为潜在推理。随后，信息增益RL阶段在无真实标签监督下自演化潜在推理。在多样化文本到图像生成基准上的实验表明，LARC持续提升生成质量、提示遵循和组合保真度。值得注意的是，LARC在GenEval上达到最先进性能，比BAGEL提升7个百

extra.description: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) achieve remarkable success on diverse multimodal understanding and generation tasks, yet they still struggle to effectively leverage language-based chain-of-thought reasoning for image generation. As a result, existing reasoning-augmented UMMs often fail to inherit the test-time scaling and fine-grained controllability observed in large language models. We attribute this failure to a fundamental modality mismatch: reasoning is performed in a discrete token space, whereas image generation operates in a continuous space. To bridge this gap, we introduce a Latent Reasoning framework in Continuous space (LARC), which alleviates the token-level bottleneck by reasoning over continuous hidden states. Specifically, the training framework consists of two stages: (i) curriculum supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and (ii) information-gain reinforcement learning (RL). First, the curriculum SFT stage gradually converts token-level reasoning into latent reasoning. Subsequently, the information-gain RL stage self-evolves latent reasoning without ground truth supervision. Experiments across diverse text-to-image generation benchmarks show that LARC consistently improves generation quality, prompt following, and compositional fidelity. Notably, LARC achieves state-of-the-art performance on GenEval with a 7%p gain over BAGEL and demonstrates clear test-time scaling behavior, outperforming token-based generation under both parallel and sequential test-time scaling strategies.

items.title: Latent Sparse Attention: Towards Subquadratic Ultra-Long Context Attention
items.title_zh: 潜在稀疏注意力：面向亚二次超长上下文注意力
items.summary_zh: 智能体工作流正日益转向长时程任务，如开放式科学工作，模型可从长上下文窗口中受益。然而，在超长上下文（超过100万token）下，全注意力成本过高。一种有前景的方法是稀疏注意力，其中专用索引器选择键的子集用于注意力。然而，当前的索引方法要么在上下文规模上仍具有二次成本，要么在超长上下文规模下损失准确性。我们通过潜在稀疏注意力（LSA）解决这一问题，这是一种在超长上下文下保持准确性的高效注意力方法。在LSA中，键在学习到的潜在空间中进行分层聚类，查询对聚类层级进行评分而非对每个键评分，从而使长上下文下的预填充、解码和训练更快。我们提出两种变体：Distilled-LSA（D-LSA），可通过蒸馏应用于预训练模型；Native-LSA（N-LSA），仅基于下一token损失原生训练。在GLM-5.3-FLASH（QWEN-3.8-27B）上，1000万token时，D-LSA相比原始稀疏注意力（

extra.description: Agentic workflows are increasingly shifting towards long-horizon tasks, such as open-ended scientific work, where models benefit from long context windows. However, at ultra-long context (above 1M tokens), full attention is prohibitively expensive. A promising approach is sparse attention, in which a dedicated indexer selects a subset of keys for the attention. Yet current methods of indexing either still have quadratic cost in context size or lose accuracy at ultra-long context scale. We address this with Latent Sparse Attention (LSA), an efficient attention method that maintains accuracy at ultra-long context. In LSA, keys are hierarchically clustered in a learned latent space, and queries score the hierarchy of clusters instead of scoring every key, making prefill, decode and training faster at long context. We propose two variants, Distilled-LSA (D-LSA), which can be applied to pre-trained models via distillation, and Native-LSA (N-LSA), which is trained natively on the next-token loss alone. On GLM-5.3-FLASH (QWEN-3.8-27B) at 10M tokens, D-LSA speeds up one attention layer by 22.7x (72.4x) in prefill and 4.6x (42.5x) in decode over its original sparse attention (full attention), while keeping similar accuracy across a variety of tasks. N-LSA matches the accuracy of full attention with a training speedup of 1.6x per layer at 128k tokens. LSA offers practical and efficient attention for models to benefit from ultra-long context.

items.title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
items.title_zh: RoboArchitect：自动化设计具有持久记忆的机器人智能体
items.summary_zh: 近期工作表明，冻结的机器人策略在智能体框架内表现远好于单独使用，其中控制代码决定何时查询策略、咨询视觉工具或直接命令机械臂。然而目前这些框架是手工构建的，并为每个新机器人或基准重新设计。我们表明框架设计可以自动化，为在新设置上微调提供了强有力的替代方案。在RoboArchitect中，编码模型观察机器人的rollout，诊断失败，并围绕冻结策略迭代修订框架。框架在一组episode上演化以进行优化，并在留出场景和任务上评估。在不更新任何模型权重的情况下，RoboArchitect在多个基准和策略上将未见场景的平均成功率从9.7%提升至43.3%（4.5倍），将未见任务的成功率从12.7%提升至40.2%（3.2倍）。当基准远离策略训练数据时增益最大：包装通用策略时，演化后的框架产生的专家往往甚至优于微调版本。直观的控制策略被自动设计，例如抬起卡住的机械臂或当上方障碍物阻挡时水平伸入。框架还

extra.description: Recent work shows that a frozen robot policy performs far better inside an agent harness, where control code decides when to query the policy, consult vision tools, or command the arm directly. Yet today these harnesses are built by hand and redesigned for each new robot or benchmark. We show that harness design can be automated, offering a strong alternative to finetuning on a novel setup. In RoboArchitect, a coding model observes a robot's rollouts, diagnoses failures, and iteratively revises the harness around the frozen policy. The harness evolves on a set of episodes for its optimization and is evaluated on held-out scenes and tasks. Without updating any model weights, RoboArchitect raises average success from 9.7% to 43.3% on unseen scenes (4.5x) and from 12.7% to 40.2% on unseen tasks (3.2x), across multiple benchmarks and policies. The gains are largest where the benchmark is far from the policy's training data: wrapping a general-purpose policy, the evolved harness yields a specialist that often outperforms even the finetuned version. Intuitive control strategies are automatically designed, such as lifting a jammed arm clear or reaching in horizontally when an obstacle blocks the way from above. The harness also evolves its own persistent memory, carrying learned experience, such as effective grasp depths, into later decisions. These results suggest that substantial headroom in robotic manipulation lies in the agent harness, and its design can be effectively automated and optimized without weight updates.

items.title: ACCT: Asymmetric Cross-LLM Context Transfer
items.title_zh: ACCT：非对称跨LLM上下文传输
items.summary_zh: 在实际部署中，大语言模型（LLM）系统正日益从单模型调用演变为动态调用不同模型进行推理的异构部署。然而，当同一上下文在模型间复用时，每个新选择的目标模型通常必须重新处理它，反复产生大量计算成本。因此，我们提出ACCT（非对称跨LLM上下文传输），针对同一模型家族内不同规模模型之间的KV缓存传输。ACCT将源模型产生的KV缓存转换为目标模型可直接消费的稀疏KV状态，从而实现上下文计算的跨模型复用，并将上下文计算与下游推理解耦。ACCT由三个轻量组件组成：Cartographer为每个目标层和KV头识别查询相关的上下文token；Allocator在共享总KV预算下确定每个目标层和KV头保留多少上下文token；Compiler将选定的源KV转换为稀疏目标KV。目标模型因此可以使用传输的KV进行推理而无需重新处理原始上下文。我们在两个互补设置中评估ACCT，包括五个通用能力基准和六个高度上下文

extra.description: In real-world deployments, large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly evolving from single-model invocation toward heterogeneous deployments in which different models are dynamically invoked for inference. When the same context is reused across models, however, each newly selected target model typically has to process it again, repeatedly incurring substantial computational costs. Therefore, we propose ACCT (Asymmetric Cross-LLM Context Transfer), which targets KV cache transfer between models of different scales within the same model family. ACCT transforms the KV cache produced by a source model into sparse KV states that can be directly consumed by a target model, thereby enabling cross-model reuse of context computation and decoupling context computation from downstream inference. ACCT consists of three lightweight components: the Cartographer identifies query-relevant context tokens for each target layer and KV head; the Allocator determines how many context tokens each target layer and KV head retains under a shared total KV budget; and the Compiler transforms selected source KV into sparse target KV. The target model can therefore perform inference using the transferred KV without reprocessing the original context. We evaluate ACCT in two complementary settings comprising five general-capability benchmarks and six highly context-dependent tasks. Experiments show that ACCT matches or exceeds the target model's original inference performance even when reducing the KV cache size by 75%. At a context length of approximately 19K tokens, ACCT's KV conversion achieves a 6.5-21.2 times speedup over target context prefill. These results demonstrate the feasibility of transferring context computation across models under a limited KV budget.

items.title: Subquadratic Attention with a Hierarchical Tree-Structured Indexer
items.title_zh: 具有分层树结构索引器的亚二次注意力
items.summary_zh: 注意力的二次缩放是限制大语言模型（LLM）长上下文能力的根本瓶颈。多种方法试图规避这一问题，但它们要么无法匹配注意力的表达能力（例如固定大小状态的滑动窗口或线性注意力变体），要么仅实现常数因子加速（例如索引器本身二次缩放的稀疏注意力方法）。在本文中，我们基于分层树结构索引器推导出一种渐近亚二次稀疏注意力方法，称为Zyphra分层注意力（ZHA）。ZHA在KV缓存上构建递归压缩键摘要的树，未来查询从顶部向下遍历以检索键的稀疏子集。关键的是，通过迭代增加树的深度，包括路由和最终注意力在内的总成本在序列长度上亚线性增长，导致注意力整体亚二次（但超线性）缩放。我们证明ZHA可以低成本应用于现有预训练模型，仅需在几十亿token上进行短暂的KL蒸馏训练阶段，并在长上下文检索和具有挑战性的推理、数学和智能体编码评估任务上保持性能。此外，我们表明我们的方法对树几何结构高度鲁棒，包括深达6层的极深树。最后

extra.description: The quadratic scaling of attention is a fundamental bottleneck limiting the long-context capabilities of large language models (LLMs). A variety of approaches have attempted to circumvent this, but they either fail to match attention's expressiveness (e.g., sliding-window or linear attention variants with fixed-size state) or only achieve constant-factor speedups (e.g., sparse attention methods whose indexers themselves scale quadratically). In this paper, we derive an asymptotically subquadratic sparse attention method based on a hierarchical, tree-structured indexer, which we call Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA). ZHA constructs a tree of recursively compressed key summaries over the KV cache, which future queries traverse from the top down to retrieve a sparse subset of keys. Crucially, by iteratively growing the tree's depth, the total cost including routing and final attention grows sublinearly in sequence length, resulting in overall subquadratic (but superlinear) scaling for attention. We demonstrate that ZHA can be cheaply applied to existing pretrained models with only a short KL distillation training stage over a few billion tokens, and maintains performance on long-context retrieval and challenging reasoning, mathematical, and agentic coding evaluation tasks. Moreover, we show that our method is highly robust to tree geometry including very deep trees of up to 6 levels. Finally, we develop a detailed performance model and show that our approach scales subquadratically, dramatically outperforms competing methods beyond 1 million context, and ultimately has the potential to extend effective context windows to the hundreds of millions or billions of tokens.

items.title: SATFRONT: Detecting Atmospheric Fronts with Satellite Data using Machine Learning
items.title_zh: SATFRONT：使用卫星数据和机器学习检测大气锋面
items.summary_zh: 大气锋面与中纬度地区大部分高影响天气相关，但其识别和分类在很大程度上仍是手动和主观的。现有的深度学习方法主要依赖网格化再分析或预报数据，限制了其对时间关键应用可用的卫星观测的适用性。我们介绍SATFRONT，一个机器学习框架，用于从地球静止卫星观测中检测欧洲上空的冷锋、暖锋和锢囚锋，再分析数据作为可选附加输入。该模型在五个欧洲国家气象服务的锋面分析上训练，并针对2024年英国气象局分析进行评估。仅使用卫星观测，SATFRONT在150公里容差下达到0.428的临界成功指数（CSI），处于不同气象服务分析之间的一致性范围内（0.277-0.501），且高于使用卫星数据的业务规则锋面检测器（0.133）。添加ERA5再分析将CSI提高至0.591。ERA5显著改善单个锋面的定位，尽管其对年度空间分布的影响因锋面类型而异。这些结果表明冷锋、暖锋和锢囚锋可以直接从地球静止卫星观测中检测，为时间关键

extra.description: Atmospheric fronts are associated with much of the high-impact weather in the mid-latitudes, yet their identification and classification remain largely manual and subjective. Existing deep learning approaches rely primarily on gridded reanalysis or forecast data, limiting their applicability to satellite observations available for time-critical applications. We introduce SATFRONT, a machine learning framework for detecting cold, warm, and occluded fronts over Europe from geostationary satellite observations, with reanalysis data as an optional additional input. The model is trained on frontal analyses from five European national meteorological services and evaluated against UK Met Office analyses for 2024. Using satellite observations alone, SATFRONT achieves a Critical Success Index (CSI) of 0.428 at a 150 km tolerance, within the range of agreement between analyses from different meteorological services (0.277-0.501) and higher than that of an operational rule-based front detector that uses satellite data (0.133). Adding ERA5 reanalysis increases the CSI to 0.591. ERA5 substantially improves the placement of individual fronts, although its effect on their annual spatial distribution varies by front type. These results demonstrate that cold, warm, and occluded fronts can be detected directly from geostationary satellite observations, providing a basis for automated frontal analyses at the high temporal frequency required for time-critical applications.

items.title: Hyperbolic Inverse Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 双曲逆强化学习
items.summary_zh: 逆强化学习（IRL）旨在推断观察行为背后的奖励函数，但其预测准确性和可解释性取决于奖励如何从底层特征计算。虽然先前的IRL奖励函数已通过多种技术实现，包括线性权重、神经网络或其他函数逼近器，但均未对底层特征空间的几何结构做出假设。受神经回路中观察到的几何组织的启发，我们引入双曲逆强化学习（Hyperbolic IRL），将奖励参数化为特征向量与学习参数向量之间双曲距离的函数，以及其欧几里得距离变体。我们在确定性和随机策略下，针对一系列线性和非线性IRL基线测试了我们的方法。我们的双曲方法在已建立的基准上达到与最先进模型相当的性能，并在低数据限制和密集环境中表现出色。应用于博物馆房间中多个展品之间的人类导航，Hyperbolic IRL揭示了不仅依赖单个展品距离特征，还依赖它们之间不可分离合取的奖励结构。总之，这些结果表明双曲奖励参数化可以同时提高IRL的预测准确性和可解释性，为研究不可分离

extra.description: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) seeks to infer the reward function underlying observed behavior, but its predictive accuracy and interpretability depend on how that reward is computed from the underlying features. While prior IRL reward functions have been implemented through a variety of techniques including linear weights, neural networks, or other function approximators, none make assumptions about the geometry of the underlying feature space. Inspired by geometric organization observed in neural circuits, we introduce Hyperbolic inverse reinforcement learning (Hyperbolic IRL), which parameterizes reward as a function of Hyperbolic distance between the feature vector and a learned parameter vector, as well as its Euclidean distance variant. We tested our methods against a range of linear and nonlinear IRL baselines under both deterministic and stochastic policies. Our Hyperbolic approach achieved comparable performance to state-of-the-art models on established benchmarks and excelled in the low data limit and across dense environments. Applied to human navigation among multiple exhibits in a museum room, Hyperbolic IRL reveals reward structure that depends not only on individual exhibit-distance features, but also on non-separable conjunctions between them. Together, these results demonstrate that a Hyperbolic reward parameterization can improve both the predictive accuracy and interpretability of IRL, providing a framework for studying how non-separable, conjunctive structure can begin to explain behavior.

items.title: Cost-Aware Stopping for Freeze-Thaw Bayesian Optimization: When Does One-Step Lookahead Suffice?
items.title_zh: 成本感知停止用于冻融贝叶斯优化：何时一步前瞻足够？
items.summary_zh: 冻融贝叶斯优化（BO）以可恢复增量评估候选者，但通常在预算或收敛测试时停止。我们最大化无预算效用，即最佳观测分数减去每次增量的成本，采用一步前瞻：推进具有最大期望改进（EI）的候选者（在固定代理模型下），一旦没有EI超过成本则停止。该规则，EI停止，在期望效用上从不低于立即停止，但可能过早停止。我们构造一个证书，即两步前瞻价值的下界，证明此类停止为时过早，重复此校正从不降低代理模型下的期望效用。在代理模型下，EI停止在低成本时平均过早，在高成本时损失很小。在三个超参数优化基准上，预注册测试发现EI停止在大多数高成本设置中非劣于校正，而校正在三个中的两个上在低成本时获益；代理模型中更多信息共享提高EI停止的效用。在两个已发表方法的代理模型上，EI停止以较低分数换取更少训练增量。EI停止是一个简单的成本感知参考，其效用取决于代理模型。

extra.description: Freeze-thaw Bayesian optimization (BO) evaluates candidates in resumable increments but usually stops at a budget or convergence test. We maximize a budget-free utility, the best observed score minus a cost per increment, with a one-step lookahead: advance the candidate with the largest expected improvement (EI) under a fixed surrogate, and stop once no EI exceeds the cost. This rule, EI stopping, never falls below stopping immediately in expected utility, yet it can stop too early. We construct a certificate, a lower bound on the value of two-step lookahead, that proves such a stop premature, and repeating this correction never lowers expected utility under the surrogate. Under the surrogate, EI stops are premature on average at low costs and lose little at high costs. On three hyperparameter optimization benchmarks, a pre-registered test finds EI stopping noninferior to the correction in most high-cost settings, while the correction gains at low costs on two of the three; more information sharing in the surrogate raises EI stopping's utility. On the surrogates of two published methods, EI stopping trades lower scores for fewer training increments. EI stopping is a simple cost-aware reference whose utility depends on the surrogate.

items.title: Differentially Private Synthetic Data from Sliced Chebyshev Moments
items.title_zh: 基于切片切比雪夫矩的差分隐私合成数据
items.summary_zh: 实用差分隐私（DP）合成数据的研究主要集中于近似保留目标分布低维边缘的方法，因此只能寄希望于幸运地保留高维全局结构。同时，现有针对全局准确性保证的方法付出随数据维度d指数增长的代价。在本工作中，我们通过提出一种新的DP合成数据算法SPLICE来解决这一“维度诅咒”，该算法即使在高维下也具有令人信服的全局分布保证，并且在实践中达到最先进水平。我们的算法基于测量目标分布的噪声切片切比雪夫多项式矩并拟合分布以匹配，这是对近期一维合成数据多项式方法的改进。我们证明，给定n个样本的数据集，在常数隐私参数下，SPLICE返回的私有分布与目标之间的切片Wasserstein-1距离为$\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$。值得注意的是，该界与数据维度d无关。在此过程中，我们证明了一个独立感兴趣的矩匹配结果：对于单位球上的分布，沿$\tilde{O}(d/α^2)$个随机方向匹配前$O(1/α)$

extra.description: Research on practical differentially private (DP) synthetic data has largely focused on methods that approximately preserve low-dimensional marginals of a target distribution, and can thus only hope to preserve higher-dimensional, global structure as a lucky by-product. At the same time, existing methods that target global accuracy guarantees pay a price exponential in the data dimension, $d$. In this work, we address this ``curse of dimensionality'' by presenting a new DP synthetic data algorithm, SPLICE, that comes with a compelling global distributional guarantee, even in high-dimensions, and moreover, is practically state-of-the-art. Our algorithm is based on measuring noisy sliced Chebyshev polynomial moments of the target distribution and fitting a distribution to match, a twist on recent polynomial methods for 1-D synthetic data. We prove that, given a dataset of $n$ examples, SPLICE returns a private distribution with Sliced Wasserstein-1 distance $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$ from the target, for constant privacy parameters. Notably, this bound is independent of the data dimension, $d$. Along the way, we prove a moment matching result of independent interest: for a distribution on the unit ball, matching the first $O(1/α)$ Chebyshev moments along $\tilde{O}(d/α^2)$ random directions guarantees $α$ Sliced Wasserstein error. Finally, we provide a practical implementation of the algorithm that borrows tools from the tensor decomposition literature and achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to prior DP synthetic data methods on an extensive benchmark.
